changelog: Public Bookings is now date-first instead of showing every reservation as a separate top-level card.
Tap a date such as Sep 3 to see all confirmed occupied Court 1 time ranges for that date.
A Request a Slot button appears directly below the selected date's booked times.
The selected booking date is prefilled automatically in the public request form.
Existing Admin booking/history workflow and the v1.3.25 0-0-2 mini game are preserved.
